Possible values: "d" (dichotomous), "m" (polychotomous ordinal categories), "n" (polychotomous nominal categories), "p" (probabilistic), "c" (continuous) "e" (ensemble). m Number observation forecast categories (required obsv.type fcst.type equals "m" "n") m2 Number forecast categories (required obsv.type fcst.type equal "m"). number observation categories specified argument m . na.rm logical; TRUE pairs obsv fcst NA removed scoring. title: Calculate Generalized Discrimination Score 2AFC — afc
text: Depending specific verification context (.e. choice obsv.type fcst.type), routine calls appropriate function(s) calculate 2AFC score. following combinations obsv.type fcst.type possible: (1) "d-d"; (2) "d-m"; (3) "d-p"; (4) "d-c"; (5) "d-e"; (6) "m-m"; (7) "m-p"; (8) "m-c"; (9) "m-e"; (10) "n-n"; (11) "n-p"; (12) "c-c"; (13) "c-e". required format input data obsv fcst depends verification context: (1) "d-d": obsv: vector dichotomous observations (values {0,1})fcst: vector length obsv dichotomous forecasts (values {0,1}) (2) "d-m": obsv: vector dichotomous observations (values {0,1})fcst: vector length obsv polychotomous forecasts (values {1,..,m}) (3) "d-p": obsv: vector dichotomous observations (values {0,1})fcst: vector length obsv forecast probabilities event happen (4) "d-c": obsv: vector dichotomous observations (values {0,1})fcst: vector length obsv real-valued forecasts (5) "d-e": obsv: vector dichotomous observations (values {0,1})fcst: two-dimensional array ensemble forecasts; dim(fcst)[1] = length(obsv); dim(fcst)[2] = ensemble size. (6) "m-m": obsv: vector polychotomous observations (values {1,..,m})fcst: vector length obsv polychotomous forecasts (values {1,..,m2}) (7) "m-p": obsv: vector polychotomous observations (values {1,..,m})fcst: two-dimensional array forecast probabilities m categories; dim(fcst)[1] = length(obsv); dim(fcst)[2] = m (8) "m-c": obsv: vector polychotomous observations (values {1,..,m})fcst: vector length obsv real-valued forecasts (9) "m-e": obsv: vector polychotomous observations (values {1,..,m})fcst: two-dimensional array ensemble forecasts; dim(fcst)[1] = length(obsv); dim(fcst)[2] = ensemble size. (10) "n-n": obsv: vector polychotomous observations (values {1,..,m})fcst: vector length obsv polychotomous forecasts (values {1,..,m}) (11) "n-p":  "m-p". (12) "c-c": obsv: vector real-valued observations fcst: vector length obsv real-valued forecasts (13) "c-e": obsv: vector real-valued observations fcst: two-dimensional array ensemble forecasts; dim(fcst)[1] = length(obsv); dim(fcst)[2] = ensemble size.
